title: Why 50 Million Chinese Homes are Empty
summary: PolyMatter explains China's housing bubble and why around 50 million homes sit empty. It covers cultural and economic reasons behind the overbuilding and the government's bind.
why: Recommended as a clear, compact explainer on China's empty homes, ghost cities and property troubles.

quote.text: it explains clearly (for a complex situation) what's been going on in China's real estate, the 'ghost cities' and the demolitions.
